title: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Within the Framework of the Multidisciplinary Consultation
off: Cohort Follow-up of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Within the Framework of the Multidisciplinary Consultation at the CHRU of Brest
summary: Diagnosis and follow up of a lupus cohort in a multidisciplinary consultation in Brest ( France)
desc: all patients coming to the LUPUS multidisciplinary consultation in brest ( France) will have a clinical examination, a biological and immunogical blood samples, cutaneous biopsies or renal biospies if necessary, an ultrasonographic articular and salivary glandular examination if needed. In case of articular involvement, some Xrays ( hands and feet) will be done at the inclusion and during the follow up each year during 5 years .
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women or men, more than 18 years old, coming to the multidisciplinary consultation in brest ( France).
* With written consentment

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients less than 18 years old
* refusing to participate
* Under legal protection
